rapport_notes: Consultative and patient — live-researched the exact spin-bike-style piano-adjacent equipment weight to answer the customer's detailed questions, and calmly walked through the pricing math when challenged.

evidence_quotes.agenda: 'What are your biggest concerns and what are the most important things you want answers to on this call today for your upcoming move?' — asked right after confirming the time was convenient, before any logistics probing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer's response was really an inventory list (7 items), not a concern to dig into, so the item was never triggered.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Customer asked 'when you say damage control, is it damage control is that main insurance?' and rep explained the $2,000 no-worries coverage and waiver process for heavy items — but no rate-commit, window, beats-it, self-prep, or feel-fair lines were delivered.

top_strength: Went the extra mile to research the exact upright piano weight/spec live on the call, matching the customer's own homework and building real credibility.
coaching_note: No quid pro quo framing and no On-Time Guarantee or Meet Your Mover differentiators were ever delivered — with a detail-oriented customer like this, those trust-builders were low-hanging fruit left on the table.
